notes: Amendment bill (H.R. 4922, Introduced/IH text). Audited source-only against data/bill-text/119-HR-4922.txt; no referencedSources registered. Every substantive prose field decomposed; all bill-content claims verified verbatim against source (age 24->18, 15-24->15-18, 180 days, 11 statistical measures, records-access overrides, Home Rule Act para (11) bar). No material issues. Open rows are non-material: two likelihoodReason procedural facts (Senate-receipt date, no-further-action) that come from cache actions metadata rather than the IH bill text, and one contextual gloss ('602(a) lists limitations'). Note the analysis correctly flags the bill's own drafting discrepancy (effective-date cites 16-2341 while (a) adds 16-2340a). featured_quotes (Donalds/Boebert/Hageman CR floor statements) not decomposed — no Congressional Record source text is registered, so they are outside source-only audit scope.
